title: Password Reset via Email
as_a: registered user who forgot my password
i_want: to reset my password via a link sent to my email
so_that: I can regain access to my account
acceptance_criteria: Given I click 'Forgot Password', I should see a form asking for my email
Given I enter a registered email and submit, I should see a confirmation message
Given I click the reset link in the email, I should be taken to a new password form
Given I enter a new password that meets complexity requirements, my password should be updated
Given I enter a password shorter than 8 characters, I should see a validation error
Given the reset link is older than 1 hour, it should be expired and show an error
notes: Reset link tokens should be single-use. Email delivery should happen within 30 seconds.

title: Dashboard Widget Customization
i_want: to rearrange and resize widgets on my dashboard
so_that: I can prioritize the information most relevant to my workflow
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the dashboard, I should see a grid of widgets
Given I drag a widget to a new position, it should snap into the grid
Given I resize a widget by dragging its corner, it should expand or shrink within grid constraints
Given I click 'Add Widget', I should see a catalog of available widgets
Given I remove a widget, it should disappear and the layout should reflow
Given I refresh the page, my custom layout should be preserved
notes: Widget state should persist in localStorage with server-side backup. Maximum 12 widgets per dashboard.

title: Collapsible Sidebar Navigation
i_want: to collapse and expand the sidebar navigation menu
so_that: I can maximize my workspace area when needed
acceptance_criteria: Given I click the collapse button, the sidebar should animate to a narrow icon-only view
Given the sidebar is collapsed, hovering over an icon should show a tooltip with the menu item name
Given I click the expand button, the sidebar should return to full width with labels
Given I navigate to a page via the sidebar, the active item should be highlighted
Given I am on a mobile viewport, the sidebar should be hidden by default with a hamburger toggle
notes: Collapse state should persist across page navigations. Transition animation should be 200ms.
